notes: §1985:VI.6.13.4 GR2 compares each WHEN phrase's objects to the subjects in ordinal position: a value or range is satisfied 'if the value, or one of the range of values, assigned to the selection object is equal to the value assigned to the selection subject' by the relation-condition rules, truth values by identity, ANY always; a phrase is selected only when every pair is satisfied, phrases tried in source order. EvaluateBinder.Bind binds each subject once into a slot, BindSelectionObject/BindWhenItem build one term per pair (CheckedRelational '==' for a value, >= and <= for a THRU range, the condition or its negation against TRUE/FALSE, ANY true) AND-ed per phrase, and EvaluateEmitter.Emit tests phrases in order, first match wins. Probes at --std 85 (all printed the expected arm): (f) an S9(18) subject equal to -999999999999999999; WHEN ZERO on S9V99; a subject changed inside the selected arm (EVALUATE I ALSO TE(I), MOVE 2 TO I) not re-evaluated; (d) X(3) 'AB' = "AB " by space padding and not = SPACES, PIC 9(3) 12 = "012", an edited item, an alphanumeric group, ALL "A" not satisfied, first of two equal arms taken; NOT 10 THRU 20 / NOT 12 rejected and NOT 13 taken, 20 THRU 10 empty, SV * 2 = -3 and D + 1 within D THRU D + 1; (a) an ODO group subject and X3(3:1) at its right bound; TRUE ALSO FALSE against two conditions, a condition subject against TRUE/FALSE, no arm and no OTHER does nothing; an alphanumeric THRU range follows the PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE; (c) the 2002 range 'IN alphabet-name' COBOL0900. Lead outside this rule: the 2002 partial-expression object (EVALUATE D WHEN > 5, WHEN IS NUMERIC) compiles and runs at --std 85 though §1985:VI.6.13.2 prints no such object (under-rejects; belongs to 1985-FMT-VI.6.13.2; no kb/Work note found). The witness selects the third of four WHEN phrases over three subjects.

next.reason: 1985: "the comparison is satisfied if the value, or one of the range of values, assigned to the selection object is equal to the value"; 2023: "If the selection object is partial-expression-1, the selection subject is placed to the left of the leading relational operator". Same left-to-right pairing for ANY, truth values, equality and THROUGH ranges, but 2023 adds partial-expression objects and NOT-negated objects (including NOT ranges), cases 1985 lacks.
